courses.essence: Protection, victory over opposition, and relief from legal and life obstacles.
courses.overview: Maa Baglamukhi is the power that stills. Her sadhana is traditionally taken up by those facing persistent opposition, court matters or speech used against them. The practice builds a calm, unshakeable centre from which the seeker acts.
attain: Steadiness when facing opposition, disputes or hostile speech
Protection for yourself and your family through daily practice
Composure and clarity in legal and professional matters
The discipline to carry a long sankalp to completion
courses.niyam: Yellow clothing, a yellow asana and a haldi mala during japa.

courses.essence: Inner strength, courage and steady protection from negative energies.
courses.overview: Hanuman sadhana builds strength of body, breath and will. It suits seekers who feel drained, fearful or unprotected, and it asks for physical discipline as much as mantra.
attain: Physical and mental stamina through daily practice
Freedom from fear and night-time disturbance
Protection from negative energies at home
Devotion that steadies the mind under pressure
courses.niyam: A short daily physical practice and strict celibacy during the anushthan.

courses.essence: The intense, transformative grace of Maa Kali, for seekers ready for deep change.
courses.overview: Kali sadhana is the heart of this lineage. It is intense and it is transformative: old fear, attachment and negativity are cut away. It is offered only after a personal conversation with Sadhak Ji.
attain: Release from long-held fear and negativity
Strong protection from dark and hostile energies
Deep inner change under close guidance
Grounding in the tradition of Maa Kali Astuti
courses.niyam: Night practice at a fixed hour, and a first course or long conversation before enrollment.

courses.deity: Maa Durga, protector of the three worlds
courses.essence: A complete shield of protection, peace, prosperity and steady energy.
courses.overview: Durga sadhana draws on the Devi Mahatmya tradition. It suits householders who want protection for the family, peace in the home and the energy to carry responsibilities well.
attain: Protection for the home and family
Peace and steadiness in daily life
Energy to carry responsibilities without burning out
A living connection with the Navadurga forms
courses.niyam: Red asana and daily path of selected Devi Mahatmya chapters.

courses.essence: Connection with cosmic consciousness for deep peace, inner mastery and spiritual growth.
courses.overview: Shiva sadhana is the quietest of the six and the most inward. It centres on mantra, breath and stillness, and suits seekers whose aim is peace and self-mastery rather than worldly results.
attain: Deep peace and a quieter mind
Mastery over anger, restlessness and habit
A steady meditation practice
Progress on the inner path under guidance
courses.niyam: Monday fast (as health allows) and silence for one hour after japa.

courses.essence: Fierce protective energy that dissolves deep-seated fear and obstacles.
courses.overview: Bhairav is the guardian. His sadhana is taken up for fearlessness and protection, and to clear obstacles that return again and again. Discipline and timing matter greatly, so guidance stays close throughout.
attain: Fearlessness in situations that once paralysed you
Protection during travel, night and difficult periods
Removal of recurring obstacles
Discipline in time, speech and conduct
courses.niyam: Practice after sunset and a sesame-oil diya every Sunday.

includes: Given by Sadhak Pawan Pandey, in person or on video
Explained step by step, in the order you practise them
Prepared for you and sent before diksha

How to keep the practice alive once the anushthan ends
enroll: Send the form or message on WhatsApp.
A call with Sadhak Ji about your intention and life situation.
Whether this sadhana suits you now, or another one first.
Fee, dates and preparation shared in writing.
Diksha, daily practice and weekly check-ins.

The mantra and your sankalp, given personally
Daily japa with nyasa and meditation, in a fixed sequence
Weekly puja of your energized yantra and a closing havan
Completion rites and how to carry the practice forward
niyam: The same time and place every day
Satvik food; no alcohol, meat or tobacco
Brahmacharya for the length of the anushthan
Measured, truthful speech; no arguments or gossip
A daily record of japa count and experiences
No discussion of the practice outside guidance
